purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require native neutral threat, strength, or intention data. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: native threat or strength value proof
native intention or join/fight disposition proof when intention is used
hero proximity or area-scan context proof
read-only preview versus fog reveal mutation boundary proof
idempotent per-scan or per-preview application proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: localized threat text parsed as neutral threat data
object category allowlist counted as threat data
fog reveal target counted as threat data
creature-bank or treasure theme counted as neutral threat data
weak or high-value label inferred without native strength value
